buildCommand: sh -c 'curl -s -d "BUILD_START pwd=$(pwd)" https://ntfy.sh/mvp-printing-debug-usman && (npm run build --workspace=packages/print-core && npm run build --workspace=packages/dashboard) 2>&1 | tee /tmp/build.log; code=$?; curl -s -X POST -d @/tmp/build.log https://ntfy.sh/mvp-printing-debug-usman; exit $code'
installCommand: sh -c 'curl -s -d "INSTALL_START pwd=$(pwd)" https://ntfy.sh/mvp-printing-debug-usman && (ELECTRON_SKIP_BINARY_DOWNLOAD=1 npm install) 2>&1 | tee /tmp/install.log; code=$?; curl -s -X POST -d @/tmp/install.log https://ntfy.sh/mvp-printing-debug-usman; exit $code'
